title_en: At the Aviation Field, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale with a Regular Layout!!!
description_en: In the field of aviation, for sale 2+1+2, with a regular floor plan!!! The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of an 11-story building with an elevator. The property has a gross surface of 117 m2. The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, a matrimonial bedroom with a toilet, a children's bedroom with an access to the balcony, and a day toilet. The orientation of the apartment is west and has a perfect organization. Currently, the construction is in the construction stage on the 2nd floor and is expected to be completed within a period of 1 year and a half.
